ablation: relative laggard score without the dispersion-contraction state
allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: A-K development evidence is already observed. Frontier-L is repeated development research, not a fresh holdout. 2023-2024 is spent.
cost_hypothesis: weekly fixed-slot portfolios should keep turnover bounded; exact ATR-linked ladder is frozen at 0/4/8/12%
failure_mode: convergence state adds no value over generic laggard selection or simply catches falling knives
falsifier: require dispersion expansion instead of contraction
nearest_incumbent: generic mean reversion / shock recovery; distinct state condition is contemporaneous cross-sectional convergence.
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: New Frontier-L hypothesis registered after K; no Frontier-L return was observed before this preregistration.
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or ablation matches/beats canonical base or if every valid base cell is below the fixed 1.0 robust-development floor; do not grid-rescue after failure
thesis: Cross-sectional laggards outperform only when relative-return dispersion is already contracting, separating convergence from unconditional mean reversion.
timing: completed daily bars only; toolbox owns execution lag; all rolling state is causal and <=365 days
validation: 2023-2024 is SPENT_DO_NOT_MUTATE and excluded from Frontier-L selection; 2025+ and live never drive mutation
